decision_rule: As in poles rounds 3-5. Corrected: the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting or trigger to the plant through a location shared by several sites, or the quote is not on the page. Confirmed: the cited page, or for a multi-row claim a sibling row's page opened 2026-11-13, carries every additive clause. Limiting parentheticals and rubric labels ('many part types', 'Rove', 'aluminum-first') are not additive. Opening lines: every clause must be carried by a stated row (value or quote) of a claim named in the reasoning, the line must end in a 'you' question, and no status may be asserted beyond its dated source. Scope (headline denominator): every stated row of the 13 plants in the delegated fields (name, address, city, state, parent_company, products, weld_processes, materials, certifications, part_size_fit, production_type, existing_robots, welder_postings, triggers, headcount, relationship); every row (any tag, with a source) of a claim cited by a score_* row or an opening line, including company (c-) and vertical rows; and the 13 opening_line rows. Other stated rows of these plants were checked too and are reported under wider_set, outside the headline.

wider_set.note: Out-of-scope rows are stated rows outside the delegated field list and not cited by any score or opening line (tier, prospect_test, website, lat/lon, county_fips, found_by, hiring_plan, hiring_context, status_detail, county_conflict, supplies links, LAD's stated bottleneck).
